swapBand.what: T12c with one kept triple's v and w swapped, all 22 terms kept, each family free
swapBand.complete: for |swap set| <= 1 (22 terms x 3 orientations = 66 rows, no work budget)
swapBand.notABand: relabelling which free vector sits in which slot: the block condition depends only on the span of {v_s (x) w_s^T}, so slot permutations cannot change a verdict

verdictMeaning: EXACT-REFUTATION of the pinned-two-families slice, complete over every base x drop-one x orientation screened. NOT a refutation of variants that also move the pinned families (those are bilinear in the unknowns, outside any linear solve), and NOT a statement about tensor rank.
scope: Refuted, exactly: the 22-term support of T12c (and of every one-term-drop of T11, T12_rank23_variant, T12d_fam_A, T12d_fam_B, naive27) with two of the three factor families pinned to the base values and the third entirely free. Unresolved: any scheme that also moves two pinned families (trilinear in the unknowns), and any support other than those screens. This is not a bound on tensor rank: 19 <= R <= 23 over Q/R is untouched.
